comparison.objective: Lift a sagging replacement pipe into line and slide a repair coupling across its joint.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual pipe alignment and close-clearance sleeve translation while the pipe pivots in an elbow.
comparison.success_condition: Coupling centered with sufficient insertion on both pipes, replacement aligned and home, hands clear, and assembly still.
comparison.reason: Tests coaxial support and translational insertion; it has no threaded setpoint, jam-nut locking, or repeated actuation check.
